source_note: Each Alloy's item text and the modifier it adds per item class, copied from its poe2db item page on 2026-09-26 (patch 0.5.5); em dashes in ranges written as hyphens, and a modifier of two lines written with a line break between them. Every Alloy poe.ninja prices in the Verisium category is here. The planner joins each line to the mod database's Alloy entries by its text.
